The first comparison shows that the fork needs a 90° rotation around the vertical axis. I’ll correct that and refine the proportions. The model is valid as a single solid.

[Open the AgentCAD model](http://127.0.0.1:8770/#part.FCStd)

slot = cq.Workplane('XY').box(42,16,44,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,0,43))
body = body.cut(slot).edges('>Z').chamfer(2)
hole = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(7.5,50,cq.Vector(0,-25,72),cq.Vector(0,1,0))
result = body.cut(hole).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),90)
